$comment: Project settings for Claude Code. This file is what makes the framework LOAD rather than
merely exist: without it, the guards are shell scripts nobody invokes and the runbooks are
COMMIT IT. Settings that live only on one machine enforce nothing on anyone else's.
Personal overrides belong in .claude/settings.local.json, which is gitignored.
The PreToolUse hook fires on EVERY Bash call, in EVERY session - including the ad-hoc
five-minute fix that never opened a runbook. That is precisely the session where close-out
obligations get skipped, so that is where enforcement belongs.
